name: neurawork-cc-harness
description: NeuraWork Claude Code harness: repo-local, self-maintaining project knowledge plus the delivery lifecycle around it. Bundles three independently installable skills — knowledge-compiler (distils session logs into a per-repo knowledge base), claudemd-lerner (keeps the CLAUDE.md hierarchy + docs/ current), and compliance-compiler (parallel agents distil GDPR/SOC2/ISO27001 into a tracked constraint catalog, derive the capabilities and stack components those constraints require, and a PostToolUse hook validates PRP plans against both) — and two workflow surfaces that need no install: /nw-worktree (create and enter a Hand worktree) and /nw-ship-pr (commit → push → PR → review → approval gate → merge → cleanup). Knowledge, docs, and the catalog always live inside the repo, never in .claude/. Recon + brownfield seed/extract on install so existing repos can be upgraded.
